name: Protagonist
source:
As a talented but struggling jazz singer, you face an impossible choice to save your ailing father by striking a desperate bargain at the crossroads with a devil by the name of Lucian Cross, a seductive music producer with a dark secret.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/Genius_Romance/status/1709554455614525787]Twitter[/url]]
